📢 ENI Airdrop: Freeze & Burn Rules

Accounts freeze only if BOTH apply:
🔹 Unclaimed rewards exceed 1 USDT
🔹 Unclaimed for over 3 days
⚠️ ≤1 USDT is exempt.

Frozen accounts: unclaimed rewards burned; new rewards paused.
🔓 Manual reactivation requires Gas; repeatable.
⏰
items.zh:
📢 ENI 空投：冻结和销毁规则

仅当两者都适用时帐户才会冻结：
🔹 无人认领的奖励超过 1 USDT
🔹超过3天无人认领
⚠️ ≤1 USDT 豁免。

账户被冻结：无人认领的奖励被烧毁；新奖励暂停。
🔓 手动重新激活需要 Gas；可重复的。
⏰
